instruction: Can you overlay workspace2.code-workspace on top of workspace1.code-workspace so that I can access folders from both workspaces in the same explorer sidebar?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VSCode does not support 'overlaying' or merging workspaces. You cannot programmatically combine two separate workspace files to display their folders together. The only way to have multiple folders in one workspace is to manually create or edit a multi-root workspace file with all desired folders, but there's no 'overlay' operation that combines existing workspace files through the UI.
